summary: The Chairman, Choo Chee Kong, offered to acquire up to 200,000 shares via private purchases from arm's-length shareholders for cash (minimum 100,000 shares); this is a non-issuer transaction with no proceeds to the company. Separately, his wholly owned EP Capital invested S$300k ($250k) in subsidiary LongevityBank, raising its stake from 6.4% to 12.0% at a post-money valuation of S$5M. The filing reports a private takeover attempt by an insider. No board recommendation, advisors, premium %, or close date are given. Watch for further share acquisition disclosures.
